## Sophia modules (sophia.html) · 1 passages

- **ep**: Giuffre was recruited at Mar-a-Lago as a teenager working as a spa attendant, and became the most prominent public accuser in the case. Her sworn allegations, made in litigation under penalty of perjury and tested across years of civil proceedings, produced the documentary record that most of this module rests on — including the depositions and exhibits released through her litigation. She settled with Epstein for $500,000 in 2009 and sued Prince Andrew in 2021, settling in February 2022. Her posthumous memoir, Nobody's Girl, was published in October 2025. She died by suicide in April 2025, aged 41. Her family's statement when Andrew lost his titles quoted her own words: he knows what happened, I know what happened, and there is only one of us telling the truth.
